paragraphs: Mentioned in [Beitzah 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.25b.11): our Rabbis relied on his statement, “I carried Rav Huna from Hini to Shili,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Beitzah has Achi Shakya carry Rav Huna in both directions. Hyman quotes only the trip from Hini to Shili.
[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=367&lang=en) likewise names Rav Huna and gives the trip in that direction.
